mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loyalty.member_benefit (id, tenant_id, program_id, member_id, benefit_id, source_type, source_id, effective_from, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{programId}, #{memberId}, #{benefitId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, now(), 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, program_id, member_id, benefit_id, source_type, source_id, effective_from, effective_to, status FROM loyalty.member_benefit WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND program_id = #{programId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND benefit_id = #{benefitId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
